thread:
mona: Dropping a small proposal: keep a compact 'overview row' at top (Org totals + quick-download) and then list workspaces below. Goal: let finance folks grab org CSV fast without losing per-workspace discoverability. Figma: https://figma.com/file/overview-row

raj: I like the idea. One-row summary reduces clicks for org exports. Question: should the overview row include a small selector for invoice period (30/90/Custom)?

taylor: Yes to period selector. Make it a stable control in the sticky toolbar so switching period doesn't cause content shift. UX note: avoid modal for period selection on desktop, use a popover.

ux-research: From last round of interviews, finance users asked for a clear "Latest invoice" action and a bulk export. They preferred a prominent org-level CTA + per-workspace quick actions.

a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist: overview row must be reachable first in tab order; period popover needs focus trap, aria-labels like "Select invoice period" and announce selection changes via aria-live. Also ensure color contrast on the summary numbers.

mona: Good points. Thinking of adding an inline toggle: "Org / Workspace" inside the overview row (small segmented control) so people don't have to scroll to top. That should be keyboard accessible.

raj: Implementation note: segmented control should be a proper radiogroup with aria-checked states. Also, pinning it in header prevents layout jump when scope changes. We'll need API param changes to accept scope + period.

taylor: For per-workspace actions: show an ellipsis menu with "Download latest invoice (CSV)" and "View usage". If user selects many workspaces, the bulk header CTA becomes "Download invoices for N workspaces". Copy nit: include file type in CTA.

ux-research: On mobile, the overview row should collapse into a single summary card + a floating action button (FAB) for downloads to save vertical space. Test that with power users.

a11y-bot: FAB must have accessible label and meet 44px touch-size. When scope switches, announce via aria-live polite.

mona: Perf note from eng: avoid rendering sparklines in overview + all rows; instead show sparklines only on hover/expand and precompute 7/30/90 aggregates server-side. We'll add that to the handoff.

raj: Sounds good. I'll add API contract doc and a small PR for the radiogroup component. Mona, can you update Figma with the overview row + sticky toolbar and leave the copy for the ellipsis actions?

mona: On it. I'll also add the exact aria-label text to the component: e.g., "Download latest invoice for <workspace name> as CSV". Thanks all :thumbsup:
